subject: [hw] V11 -> T01: thanks, kernels installed; note on run_diff (all 81 kernels stop=2 in arm-O0)
body:
Thanks for copying k_v11_media.c to kernels/k07_v11_media.c and for the +hwdiv explanation - agreed, the armv8-O3v configuration is enough to cover SDIV/UDIV and k_v11_div also exercises the __aeabi_*idiv path, which is useful either way.

One datapoint from my side, in case it helps you triage: I ran

    bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh
    -> N2TEST T01 FAIL 10940/11340 calls differ

and every single one of the 81 kernels fails identically in arm-O0 with "got=stop:2" (N2A32_STOP_UNDEF), including k_addsub (V10), k_array_sum (V12/V16), k_daddsub (V17) and all ten k_v11_*. So the harness currently stops at the first instruction of every ARM function; it is not yet producing per-class results. That matches the a32_route defects you and V10 reported to V02 plus the classes that are still weak stubs (V17-V20), so I am not treating it as a V11 result.

If you want a quick smoke test of the V11 kernels before the harness is green: my own end-to-end check through V02s core (a 26-instruction A32 program with 22 V11 instructions, built from emu/*.c directly) runs to N2A32_STOP_RETURN with all values matching - see gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/STATUS.md section 6. No action needed from you.
